spans.s: A corner, an angle (of anything); भयेन कोणे क्वचन स्थितस्य
An intermediate point of the compass.
The bow of a lute; a fiddle-stick.
The sharp edge of a sword or weapon.

A sort of musical instrument [cf. Gr. gonia].
.━{@Comp.@}: कोणाघातः, कोणकुणः, कोणपारावतम्, कोणवादिन्, कोणवृत्तम्, कोणशङ्कुः

+ -आघातः striking of drums, tabors &c., used in the sense of ‘a mingled sound of various musical instruments’

+ -कुणः, -पारावतम् (see कपोतपालिका) A dove-cot or doveridge, a bug.
+ -कुणः, -पारावतम् (see कपोतपालिका) A dove-cot or doveridge, a bug.

+ -वृत्तम् a vertical circle extending from north-east to south-west
 or from north-west to south-east.
+ -शङ्कुः the sinus of the height of the sun.

कोणाकोणि^1 ind. From angle to angle, corner-wise, diagonally.
